cause: Windows dynamically excludes TCP8061-8160 after the observed Docker/runtime restart; Main8088/8090 both fall inside it. Restarting only existing Main publishers did not restore host listeners.
scope: Temporary Main loopback host port change only
user_impact: Host browser/API base URLs change to localhost18088/18089 temporarily; old8088/8090 remain unavailable while Windows owns their range. Verify browser/login/relativeAPIlinks before treating UI as ready. No bypass of existing browser tool policy.
rollback: Restore only original two Main mappings after Windows releases8088/8090; retain databases/history, same images. No global Docker/WSLrestart or OSnetwork changes.
reason_for_decision: Existing user constraint preserves APIcontracts; changing user-visibleMain URLs requires choosing recovery strategy.
user_decision: Keep8088/8090; user handles Windows exclusion with guidance. Agent must not apply alternate mappings or OSnetwork changes.
